name: catalog-viewport-state-names
goal: Keep named states ending in viewport names distinct in catalog evidence.

evidence: The explorer-pages-screen catalog guard cannot select platform-details desktop at desktop, although the state is captured at all three viewports.

The focused evidence projection strips a matching viewport suffix when an unrelated base state exists. Strengthen the existing catalog guard for an explicitly named desktop state and keep legacy device-state coverage.
At 34c29f8982 the catalog guard expected the named desktop state capture and received undefined; red record 2c0cde4e0e8d.
